Keep the sections of your kind and delete the others:
- A question to decide: Question, What we know (with sources), Options, Definition of done, Goal clause.
- A build: Why, Definition of done, Goal clause.
- A follow-up: What was seen, Ask, Goal clause.

Dependencies: end the body with one line, for example "Depends on #60" or
"Depends on #12, #34". The keyword (Blocked by / Depends on / Requires) and
every issue number must be on that same line. The triage parser reads
references only from the same line as the keyword; references under a heading
or on the next line are ignored, and the issue is then treated as unblocked.
An issue never depends on itself. Delete the line if there is no dependency.

Goal clause: one line, the clause number and its heading, for example
"- G2 Permissions and hooks are distributed at delegation time and take effect".
